name: canli-fundamentals-mcp
description: SEC company fundamentals point in time: what was first reported, what was known on a date, and every later restatement.
long_description: For any value a company reported to the SEC in XBRL: what was first reported, what the latest filing says, and what was known on a given date, each with the filing behind it. Computed on this computer from a hash-checked SEC snapshot served by canlicapital.com; no key or account. Company-reported data, not investment advice.

tools.name: restatements
tools.description: Periods whose value changed in a later filing

tools.name: vintages
